description: All candidates use the unchanged Phase46 evaluator. Candidate selection is multi-metric, not minimum loss. Tolerances govern this experiment only; Phase46 recorded gate remains unchanged.
greedy_note: Runaway alone never rejects. Earlier loop onset together with higher repetition and confidence is negative evidence; isolated conflicting loop signals are reported as mixed, not decisive.
selection: A reduced LR is a clear candidate only if all safety checks pass, Rare CE improves by >=0.05 versus A, and loop onset/repetition/confidence do not jointly worsen. Among eligible candidates prefer lower Rare CE; difference <0.02 prefers the smaller LR change (B). If none qualify, best=null and no further-seed training.
confirmation: Reuse selected seed42 experiment, train only remaining seeds 123 and 2026 once. Apply same checks to each seed and report aggregate. Never promote experimental checkpoints.
